title: VulDec: Vulnerability Detection in Binaries via Neural Decompilation
title_zh: VulDec：基于神经反编译的二进制漏洞检测

paragraphs.en: Automated vulnerability detection in binary executables is challenging due to the lack of source code and the limited semantic information available at the assembly level. Despite significant progress in machine-learning-based code analysis, the field still lacks methodologies and large, high-quality datasets that provide vulnerable code jointly at assembly- and source-level with precise vulnerability labels. To address this gap, we introduce VulDec, consisting of (i) a new large-scale, carefully curated dataset aligning real-world Assembly–C function pairs with detailed CWE annotations across multiple architectures, and (ii) the first end-to-end framework that leverages neural decompilation for binary vulnerability detection. Tuned LLM-based neural decompilers trained on our dataset achieve strong source-level recovery across architectures (Edit Similarity of approximately 56%, BLEU-4 of approximately 43%), while our tuned LLM-based detectors reach a macro F1-score of 0.61 on an in-distribution realistic test set (3% vulnerability rate). Our findings provide evidence that neural decompilation offers a powerful alternative to conventional low-level binary representations, facilitating robust binary vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 由于缺乏源代码且汇编层面可用的语义信息有限，对二进制可执行文件进行自动化漏洞检测极具挑战性。 尽管基于机器学习的代码分析已取得显著进展，该领域仍然缺乏相应方法论以及大规模、高质量的数据集——即能在汇编级和源码级同时提供带精确漏洞标注的易受攻击代码的数据集。 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 VulDec，其包含：(i) 一个新的大规模、精心整理的数据集，该数据集将真实世界的汇编–C 函数对与跨多种架构的详细 CWE 标注对齐；(ii) 首个利用神经反编译进行二进制漏洞检测的端到端框架。 在我们的数据集上训练并调优的基于大语言模型的神经反编译器在多种架构上实现了强大的源码级恢复能力（编辑相似度约为 56%，BLEU-4 约为 43%）；同时，我们调优的基于大语言模型的检测器在符合分布的真实测试集（漏洞率为 3%）上达到了 0.61 的宏平均 F1 分数。 我们的研究结果为以下观点提供了证据：神经反编译为传统低级二进制表示提供了一种强大的替代方案，有助于实现鲁棒的二进制漏洞检测。

paragraphs.en: Binary-based vulnerability detection represents a critical challenge in automated and trustworthy software engineering, as vulnerabilities in executable files can be exploited to compromise entire systems. Unlike approaches that rely on source code ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2018 ; Russell et al., 2018 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) , binary-based vulnerability detection is essential in scenarios where the source code is unavailable, such as proprietary software, legacy systems, and firmware embedded in specialized hardware. As a matter of fact, many attack techniques target compiled binaries rather than source code, making binary-based analysis useful for robust system security ( Shoshitaishvili et al., 2016 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于二进制的漏洞检测是自动化与可信软件工程中的一项关键挑战，因为可执行文件中的漏洞可能被利用来危害整个系统。 与依赖源代码的方法不同，在源代码不可用的场景下，例如专有软件、遗留系统以及嵌入专用硬件的固件，基于二进制的漏洞检测至关重要。 事实上，许多攻击技术针对的是编译后的二进制文件而非源代码，这使得基于二进制的分析对稳健的系统安全非常有用。

paragraphs.en: Several studies have explored binary-based vulnerability detection by leveraging different low-level representations, such as disassembled code ( Dahl et al., 2020 ) , LLVM IR ( Schaad and Binder, 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2019 ) , and code graphs ( Eschweiler et al., 2016 ; Grieco et al., 2016 ; Pewny et al., 2015 ) . However, these representations largely preserve assembly-level structure and semantics, limiting their suitability for vulnerability detection approaches that rely on high-level abstractions rather than low-level instruction patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 一些研究通过利用不同的低层表示探索了基于二进制的漏洞检测，例如反汇编代码（Dahl 等，2020）、LLVM IR（Schaad 和 Binder，2023；Zheng 等，2019）以及代码图（Eschweiler 等，2016；Grieco 等，2016；Pewny 等，2015）。 然而，这些表示在很大程度上保留了汇编级的结构和语义，限制了它们在依赖高层抽象而非低层指令模式的漏洞检测方法中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: Since vulnerability detection in source code is far more mature and supported by a well-established state of the art, binary-level detection can be approached as a standard vulnerability detection task by using decompilation , which converts binaries into high-level code and allows existing techniques to be applied.
paragraphs.zh: 由于源代码中的漏洞检测已经非常成熟，并拥有完善的技术基础，因此二进制级别的检测可以通过反编译作为一种标准的漏洞检测任务来处理，反编译将二进制文件转换为高级代码，从而使现有技术得以应用。

paragraphs.en: As found by Cao et al. (2024) , traditional decompilers struggle to generate human-readable and well-structured code, often producing output that remains too close to raw assembly. Consequently, they fail to fully exploit the advantages of high-level program abstraction, reducing their effectiveness in automated security analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 正如 Cao 等人所发现的 （2024），传统的反编译器难以生成人类可读且结构良好的代码，其输出往往过于接近原始汇编代码。 因此，它们无法充分利用高级程序抽象的优势，降低了其在自动化安全分析中的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we propose the use of neural decompilation , a generative approach that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to translate binaries back into source code. The process begins by disassembling the binary into assembly code, followed by decompilation into high-level code. This methodology produces a decompiled program that closely mirrors the original source, utilizing the transformer encoder-decoder architecture to capture the semantic richness inherent in real-world code.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出使用神经反编译，这是一种生成式方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）将二进制文件转换回源代码。 该过程首先将二进制文件反汇编为汇编代码，然后将其反编译为高级代码。 这种方法生成的反编译程序与原始源代码高度相似，它利用 transformer 编码器-解码器架构来捕捉现实世界代码中固有的丰富语义。

paragraphs.en: Gaining access to the reconstructed source code supports a range of further applications, from malware identification to comprehensive static analysis, and, in particular, enables automated vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 获取重构后的源代码可以支持一系列进一步的应用，从恶意软件识别到全面的静态分析，尤其能够实现自动化的漏洞检测。

paragraphs.en: Along this direction, vulnerability detection on decompiled code poses non-trivial challenges. Neurally-decompiled programs, as pointed out by Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt (2022) , are often incomplete, non-canonical, and lack the semantic guaranties expected by source-level analysis tools, such as precise type information and whole-program context. Most traditional methods do not natively operate at function-level granularity ( Pistoia et al., 2007 ) ; moreover, they tend to produce a high number of false positives ( Ayewah et al., 2007 ) . As a result, static vulnerability detectors tend to degrade or fail when applied to decompiled code. In this context, machine learning-based approaches, and in particular LLMs, are an appealing solution to mitigate the approximations and uncertainty introduced by decompilation, making them well-suited for vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 沿着这一方向，对反编译代码进行漏洞检测面临着不小的挑战。 正如 Hosseini 和 Dolan-Gavitt（2022）所指出的，神经反编译生成的程序往往不完整、非规范化，并且缺乏源代码级分析工具所期望的语义保证，例如精确的类型信息和全程序上下文。 大多数传统方法并不能原生地在函数级粒度上运行（Pistoia 等，2007）；此外，它们往往会产生大量的误报（Ayewah 等，2007）。 因此，静态漏洞检测器在应用于反编译代码时往往会出现性能下降或失效。 在此背景下，基于机器学习的方法，尤其是大语言模型（LLMs），成为缓解反编译所带来的近似与不确定性的一种有吸引力的解决方案，使其非常适合用于漏洞检测。

paragraphs.en: A further issue concerns existing state-of-the-art datasets: they address neural decompilation and vulnerability detection in isolation. Decompilation benchmarks ( da Silva et al., 2021 ; Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt, 2022 ; Katz et al., 2018 ; Yang et al., 2011 ) provide source–binary pairs without security annotations, while vulnerability datasets ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Fan et al., 2020 ; Ni et al., 2024 ; NIST, 2017 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) are mostly at the source-level and lack corresponding binaries. Although there exist CWE-annotated datasets that can be compiled to obtain corresponding binaries, e.g., the Juliet Test Suite C/C++ ( NIST, 2017 ) , these resources typically rely on synthetic code. Prior work ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ) has shown that synthetic samples often fail to capture real-world vulnerability patterns, thereby limiting their effectiveness in practical scenarios. Since detection operates on pseudo-C code generated by the decompiler, training both models on a shared data distribution ensures semantic consistency across pipeline stages and mitigates distribution shift between training and inference.

paragraphs.en: In light of these concerns, we propose VulDec, an end-to-end framework to detect vulnerabilities in binaries using neural decompilation and LLM-based vulnerability detection . Figure 1 shows an illustrative example of our pipeline, from binary to vulnerability detection. To enable end-to-end approaches that bridge different abstraction levels, our framework includes a large-scale, carefully curated dataset that provides a direct mapping between real-world C–Assembly function pairs, complemented by detailed CWE annotations across multiple architectures.

paragraphs.en: This work aims to demonstrate that neural decompilation constitutes an effective approach for binary vulnerability detection, supporting its adoption for this purpose.

paragraphs.en: We introduce the VulDec framework, an automated LLM-based decompilation-classification pipeline to detect vulnerabilities in binaries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 VulDec 框架，这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化反编译-分类流水线，用于检测二进制文件中的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Given the lack of large-scale datasets explicitly linking low-level assembly to high-level vulnerable source code, we present the VulDec dataset 1 1 1 Available on Figshare . , a collection of more than 59,000 (non-)vulnerable C-ASM program pairs extracted from 7,000 real-world commits, whose assembly is lifted directly from official Debian packages ( The Debian Project, 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于缺乏明确将低级汇编代码与高级易受攻击源代码相关联的大规模数据集，我们提出了 VulDec 数据集 1 1 1 可在 Figshare 上获取。 ，该数据集包含从 7,000 个真实世界提交中提取的超过 59,000 个（非）易受攻击的 C-ASM 程序对，其汇编代码直接从官方 Debian 软件包中提升而来（The Debian Project, 2025）。

paragraphs.en: We perform an extensive evaluation, showing that fine-tuned LLM-based neural decompilers achieve strong source-level recovery across architectures (Edit Similarity ≈ \approx 56%, BLEU-4 ≈ \approx 43%), while our tuned LLM-based detectors reach a macro F1-score of 0.61 on an in-distribution realistic test set (3% vulnerability rate).
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了广泛的评估，结果表明经过微调的基于 LLM 的神经反编译器在多种架构上实现了较强的源代码级恢复能力（编辑相似度 ≈ \approx 56%，BLEU-4 ≈ \approx 43%），而我们调优的基于 LLM 的检测器在分布内的真实测试集（漏洞率为 3%）上达到了 0.61 的宏 F1 分数。

paragraphs.en: Decompilation aims to recover high-level program representations from executable code, reversing the transformations applied during compilation and linking. While the forward compilation pipeline, i.e., from high-level language to assembly, object code, and finally executable, is well defined, the reverse process is inherently ill-posed. Disassembly, which lifts binary code to assembly, is largely supported by mature tools; however, no deterministic inverse exists for decompilation, as compilation irreversibly discards high-level semantic information. This challenge primarily arises from the semantic gap between high- and low-level code. Executable binaries lack explicit abstractions such as functions, data types, and structured control constructs, which are instead implemented through low-level jumps, calls, and register manipulations. As a result, reconstructing the original control flow and program structure from binary code is highly non-trivial. An additional drawback is the strong architectural dependence (e.g., x86, ARM, MIPS) of low-level code. While high-level languages are largely architecture-agnostic, executable binaries are tightly coupled to the target instruction set, calling conventions, and register models. This dependency further complicates decompilation, as the same high-level construct may be realized through substantially different instruction sequences across architectures.

paragraphs.en: Traditional decompilers rely on static program analysis techniques to reconstruct high-level representations from binary executables. Widely used tools such as Ghidra ( National Security Agency, 2019 ) , IDA Pro ( Hex-Rays, 2025 ) , and RetDec ( Avast Software, 2017 ) operate on intermediate representations; P-code in Ghidra, microcode IR in IDA, and LLVM IR in RetDec. They are derived from control-flow graphs (CFGs), where basic blocks and their transitions are explicitly modeled, and may further enrich them with data-flow graphs (DFGs) and program dependence graphs (PDGs) to track variable usage and dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 传统反编译器依赖静态程序分析技术从二进制可执行文件中重建高级表示。 广泛使用的工具如 Ghidra（National Security Agency, 2019）、IDA Pro（Hex-Rays, 2025）和 RetDec（Avast Software, 2017）都在中间表示上进行操作：Ghidra 使用 P-code，IDA 使用微码 IR，RetDec 使用 LLVM IR。 它们派生自控制流图（CFG），其中基本块及其转移被显式建模，并可进一步用数据流图（DFG）和程序依赖图（PDG）加以丰富，以跟踪变量的使用和依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: However, as stated by Cao et al. (2024) and Cotroneo et al. (2025b) , traditional decompilers exhibit intrinsic limitations rooted in their reliance on static analysis and rule-based transformations. Their effectiveness critically depends on the availability of well-formed, fully compilable binaries , as accurate control-flow and data-flow recovery require complete functions and closed control-flow graphs. This constraint limits their applicability in scenarios involving partial code fragments, dynamically generated code, or isolated binary snippets. Furthermore, despite traditional decompilers producing syntactically valid outputs, the reconstructed representations are often semantically approximate, assembly-like , and verbose, reflecting low-level implementation details rather than high-level program intent. Intermediate representations are designed for deterministic structural analysis rather than semantic abstraction. Finally, the strong coupling to predefined architectures and handcrafted heuristics hinders robustness across different compiler configurations and target platforms, motivating the exploration of neural decompilation approaches that relax these assumptions by learning semantic patterns directly from data.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，正如 Cao 等人 （2024）和 Cotroneo 等人 （2025b）所指出的，传统反编译器存在固有的局限性，其根源在于对静态分析和基于规则的变换的依赖。 它们的有效性严重依赖于格式良好、完全可编译的二进制文件，因为准确的控制流和数据流恢复需要完整的函数和闭合的控制流图。 这一约束限制了它们在涉及部分代码片段、动态生成代码或孤立二进制片段的场景中的适用性。 此外，尽管传统反编译器能产生语法上有效的输出，但其重构的表示往往在语义上只是近似、类似于汇编且冗长，反映的是底层实现细节而非高层程序意图。 中间表示是为确定性的结构分析而设计的，而非面向语义抽象。 最后，与预定义架构和手工启发式规则的强耦合阻碍了其在不同编译器配置和目标平台上的鲁棒性，这促使人们探索神经反编译方法，通过直接从数据中学习语义模式来放宽这些假设。

paragraphs.en: Previously explored by several works ( Cotroneo et al., 2025b ; Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt, 2022 ; Katz et al., 2018 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) , neural decompilation has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional rule-based approaches by framing decompilation as a learning problem rather than a deterministic reconstruction task. Instead of explicitly modeling control-flow recovery and semantic lifting through handcrafted heuristics, neural models learn latent representations that capture recurring semantic patterns across large corpora of compiled programs. This paradigm enables training on paired sequences of low-level and high-level code, effectively casting decompilation as a translation task . Such a data-driven approach facilitates the implicit modeling of semantic patterns that are difficult to encode explicitly, allowing neural decompilers to recover representations that are generally more C-like , structured, and readable than those produced by traditional tools. A key advantage lies in their increased flexibility with respect to input completeness and variability, as neural models can operate on code fragments or isolated functions, making them applicable even when fully compilable binaries are unavailable.

paragraphs.en: Despite these advantages, neural decompilation also presents notable challenges. Code generation models inherently carry the risk of not consistently providing syntactically correct or relevant code. The performance of neural models heavily depends on the availability and quality of large-scale paired datasets of binaries and source code, whose construction is non-trivial and may introduce bias toward specific compilers, optimization levels, or programming styles. Additionally, neural decompilers may struggle with generalization beyond the training distribution and often lack the interpretability and deterministic guarantees provided by traditional analysis-based tools. As a result, neural decompilation should be viewed not as a replacement but as a complementary approach to traditional decompilation, particularly in contexts requiring scalable and semantics-aware analysis.

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability detection is a well-established problem in software security, aiming to identify programming errors and security flaws that may lead to exploitable behaviors. Existing approaches can be broadly categorized into source-level and binary-level vulnerability detection. Source-level techniques ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Cotroneo et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2018 ; Russell et al., 2018 ; Wheeler, 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) operate on high-level code representations and benefit from explicit program semantics, structured control flow, and rich contextual information, enabling precise analysis through static analysis, dynamic analysis, symbolic execution, or learning-based methods. ML-based approaches ( Dahl et al., 2020 ; Eschweiler et al., 2016 ; Grieco et al., 2016 ; Schaad and Binder, 2023 ; Pewny et al., 2015 ; Zheng et al., 2019 ) are particularly suitable for large or diverse code fragments, as they can capture recurring vulnerability patterns without requiring extensive handcrafted rules. In contrast, binary-level vulnerability detection operates directly on executable code, where the lack of high-level abstractions and semantic information significantly complicates the analysis.

paragraphs.en: Decompilation plays a crucial role in enabling binary-level vulnerability detection by recovering higher-level program representations from executables, thus allowing the application of mature source-level vulnerability detection techniques in binary-only settings. In this context, neural decompilation, by producing more structured and semantically expressive representations, provides a promising mechanism for transferring source-level security analyzes to binaries. However, despite this potential, decompilation has largely remained a support tool for code readability and manual reverse engineering ( Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt, 2022 ) , rather than being systematically integrated into automated security analysis pipelines. Consequently, existing approaches often fail to fully exploit recovered semantic information for security-driven tasks, motivating the development of methods that tightly couple neural decompilation with vulnerability detection to enable scalable and effective binary-level analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 反编译通过从可执行文件中恢复更高级别的程序表示，在二进制级别的漏洞检测中发挥着关键作用，从而使得成熟的源代码级漏洞检测技术能够应用于仅有二进制的场景。 在这一背景下，神经反编译通过生成更具结构化且语义表达更丰富的表示，为将源代码级安全分析迁移到二进制程序提供了一种有前景的机制。 然而，尽管具备这一潜力，反编译在很大程度上仍然只是作为提升代码可读性和人工逆向工程的辅助工具（ Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt, 2022 ），而未被系统地集成到自动化安全分析流水线中。 因此，现有方法往往无法充分利用所恢复的语义信息来执行面向安全的任务，这促使人们开发将神经反编译与漏洞检测紧密耦合的方法，以实现可扩展且高效的二进制级别分析。

paragraphs.en: Existing datasets typically support neural decompilation and vulnerability detection in isolation. Decompilation datasets ( da Silva et al., 2021 ; Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt, 2022 ; Katz et al., 2018 ; Yang et al., 2011 ) focus on paired source–binary representations but lack security annotations, whereas vulnerability detection datasets ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Fan et al., 2020 ; Ni et al., 2024 ; NIST, 2017 ; Russell et al., 2018 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) are primarily defined at the source level and do not include corresponding binaries. Many widely used vulnerability datasets are synthetic ( NIST, 2017 ) , cover a limited set of vulnerability patterns ( Russell et al., 2018 ) , or do not strictly follow standardized taxonomies such as CWE ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) . Moreover, they rarely ensure full compilability ( Chakraborty et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Fan et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) , limiting their applicability in studying how source-level vulnerabilities manifest at the binary level. As a consequence, unified datasets that jointly capture source code, binaries, and vulnerability annotations remain largely unavailable, hindering the development of end-to-end approaches that integrate decompilation and vulnerability detection.

paragraphs.en: This section introduces the proposed VulDec framework for binary vulnerability detection and the construction of the VulDec dataset used to support its training and evaluation.

paragraphs.en: The effectiveness of neural decompilation for vulnerability detection critically depends on the availability of a high-quality dataset that provides aligned source-level and binary-level representations, along with reliable vulnerability annotations. (2023) , a large-scale collection of vulnerable and non-vulnerable C/C++ functions mined from real-world open-source projects and annotated via vulnerability-fixing commits. paragraphs.en: This work introduces VulDec, an end-to-end framework for vulnerability detection directly from binary executables. Given a compiled binary, VulDec first extracts its assembly representation using a static, architecture-aware disassembler. The resulting assembly code is then processed by a neural decompilation module to reconstruct a high-level approximation of the original source code. Finally, a neural vulnerability detection module analyzes the recovered source representation to determine whether the function contains security vulnerabilities. Figure 3 illustrates the overall pipeline and the intermediate representations produced at each stage.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作提出了 VulDec，一个可直接从二进制可执行文件进行漏洞检测的端到端框架。 给定一个编译后的二进制文件，VulDec 首先使用静态的、面向体系结构的反汇编器提取其汇编表示。 得到的汇编代码随后由神经反编译模块处理，以重构原始源代码的高层近似。 最后，神经漏洞检测模块分析恢复出的源代码表示，以判断该函数是否包含安全漏洞。 图 3 展示了整体流程以及每个阶段产生的中间表示。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 4 , the framework is trained through two distinct yet complementary learning tasks. Neural decompilation is formulated as a sequence-to-sequence translation task, in which pre-trained large language models are fine-tuned to map sequences of assembly instructions to semantically equivalent high-level source code written in C or C++. The objective is to learn a conditional transformation from low-level binary representations to structured, human-readable code. All samples are defined at the function level, with variable-length instruction and token sequences, and the decompilation process operates in a controlled setting that excludes compiler optimizations and code obfuscation.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 4 所示，该框架通过两个不同但互补的学习任务进行训练。 神经反编译被构建为一个序列到序列的翻译任务，其中对预训练大语言模型进行微调，以将汇编指令序列映射为语义等价的 C 或 C++ 高级源代码。 目标是学习一种从低层二进制表示到结构化、人类可读代码的条件变换。 所有样本均在函数级别定义，具有可变长度的指令序列和词元序列，且反编译过程在受控设置下运行，不包括编译器优化和代码混淆。

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability detection, in contrast, is formulated as a binary classification task. Here, pretrained large language models are fine-tuned to analyze the decompiled C/C++ code and predict whether a function is vulnerable (1) or non-vulnerable (0). The detection model is trained on C/C++ source code and is applied at inference to decompiled pseudo-C/C++, reflecting realistic deployment conditions. By integrating disassembly, neural decompilation, and automated vulnerability analysis, VulDec enables vulnerability assessment in the absence of the original source code.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，漏洞检测被表述为一个二分类任务。 在这里，预训练大语言模型经过微调，用于分析反编译的 C/C++ 代码，并预测某个函数是否存在漏洞（1）或不存在漏洞（0）。 检测模型在 C/C++ 源代码上训练，并在推理时应用于反编译的伪 C/C++ 代码，这反映了真实的部署条件。 通过整合反汇编、神经反编译和自动化漏洞分析，VulDec 能够在没有原始源代码的情况下进行漏洞评估。

paragraphs.en: VulDec is a real-world C/ASM dataset for function-level vulnerability analysis across x86 and ARM architectures. We adopted two widely deployed ISAs (Instruction Set Architectures), representative of both server and embedded/IoT domains. These architectures follow fundamentally different design philosophies (CISC and RISC), allowing us to capture substantial variability at the assembly level and evaluate the generality of the proposed approach across clearly different low-level representations. The automated compilation of the binary artifacts was performed using the standard Debian toolchain (via apt-get --build source ). We targeted the source packages through the distribution’s build utilities, employing the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) version 12.2.0 compiler suite with the -O2 optimization level to ensure a consistent and reproducible production environment. The assembly code is obtained from binary executables using llvm-objdump ( The LLVM Foundation, 2026 ) , a static, architecture-aware disassembler operating at the instruction level.
paragraphs.zh: VulDec 是一个面向真实场景的 C/ASM 数据集，用于跨 x86 和 ARM 架构的函数级漏洞分析。 我们采用了两种广泛部署的指令集架构（ISA），它们分别代表了服务器领域和嵌入式/IoT 领域。 这些架构遵循截然不同的设计理念（CISC 和 RISC），使我们能够在汇编层面捕捉到显著的多样性，并在明显不同的低级表示上评估所提出方法的通用性。 二进制制品的自动化编译使用标准 Debian 工具链完成（通过 apt-get --build source）。 我们通过发行版的构建工具处理源码包，采用 GNU 编译器套件（GCC）12.2.0 版本以及 -O2 优化级别，以确保一致且可复现的生产环境。 汇编代码使用 llvm-objdump（The LLVM Foundation, 2026）从二进制可执行文件中获取，这是一款静态的、架构感知的、工作在指令级别的反汇编器。

paragraphs.en: VulDec covers a diverse set of widely used open-source projects, including Linux, OpenSSL, QEMU, FFmpeg, and Git, with substantial variability in project size. Across both architectures, the most prevalent vulnerability classes are consistently CWE-703, CWE-119, and CWE-20, indicating that improper control flow validation, memory corruption vulnerabilities, and input validation issues dominate in both ARM and x86 binaries. Detailed dataset statistics and per-project function counts for both architectures are reported in Appendix 10 .

paragraphs.en: For the neural decompilation phase, transformer-based models were fine-tuned to translate assembly code into C/C++ source code. To assess the suitability of different neural architectures for translation, we adopted several representative models from diverse design paradigms. All models are pre-trained on large-scale code corpora and are subsequently fine-tuned on VulDec for the neural decompilation task.
paragraphs.zh: 在神经反编译阶段，我们对基于 Transformer 的模型进行了微调，用于将汇编代码翻译为 C/C++ 源代码。 为了评估不同神经架构在翻译任务中的适用性，我们采用了来自多种设计范式的若干代表性模型。 所有模型均在大规模代码语料库上进行了预训练，随后在 VulDec 上针对神经反编译任务进行微调。

paragraphs.en: Qwen2.5-Coder 3B ( Hui et al., 2024 ) , a decoder-only large language model optimized specifically for code, included to evaluate the capabilities of a highly capable, dense, instruction-tuned model trained on extensive multilingual code repositories.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen2.5-Coder 3B（Hui et al., 2024），一个专门针对代码优化的仅解码器（decoder-only）大语言模型，将其纳入以评估一个在大量多语言代码仓库上训练的、能力强大且经过指令微调的稠密模型的能力。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 1.3B ( Guo et al., 2024 ) is selected to assess the performance of a instruction-tuned decoder-only model that leverages repository-level code completion and a mix of project-level context during its pre-training phase.
paragraphs.zh: 选择 DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 1.3B（Guo et al., 2024）来评估一个经过指令微调的仅解码器（decoder-only）模型的性能，该模型在预训练阶段利用了仓库级代码补全和项目级上下文的混合。

paragraphs.en: CodeT5+ 220M ( Wang et al., 2023 ) is employed as a reference encoder–decoder model, leveraging span-denoising pre-training and a hybrid architecture that has demonstrated strong performance in both code understanding and generation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: CodeT5+ 220M（Wang et al., 2023）被用作参考的编码器–解码器模型，它利用了跨度去噪预训练和一种混合架构，该架构在代码理解与生成任务中均表现出强大的性能。

paragraphs.en: CodeBERT 125M ( Feng et al., 2020 ) , an encoder-only model based on RoBERTa, is included to evaluate the effectiveness of rich contextual representations during the encoding of assembly instructions. In our approach, it is coupled with a seq-to-seq decoder, forming a full encoder–decoder architecture.

paragraphs.en: CodeGPT 124M ( Radford et al., 2019 ) and CodeParrot 110M ( Tunstall et al., 2022 ) , both decoder-only autoregressive models, are adopted to assess the flexibility of generation-only architectures when applied to a translation task not explicitly targeted during pre-training.
paragraphs.zh: 采用 CodeGPT 124M（Radford et al., 2019）和 CodeParrot 110M（Tunstall et al., 2022）这两种仅解码器的自回归模型，来评估仅生成式架构在应用于预训练期间未明确针对的翻译任务时的灵活性。

paragraphs.en: PLBART 140M ( Ahmad et al., 2021 ) , an encoder–decoder model derived from BART and trained using multi-task denoising objectives on code and natural language, is considered to explore its ability to reconstruct structured high-level code from low-level inputs.
paragraphs.zh: PLBART 140M（Ahmad et al., 2021）是一个从 BART 衍生而来的编码器–解码器模型，通过在代码和自然语言上使用多任务去噪目标进行训练。我们将其纳入研究，以探索其从低层输入重建结构化高层代码的能力。

paragraphs.en: We performed a stratified split between training, validation, and testing in a ratio of 90 / 5 / 5 90/5/5 . The dataset was partitioned using a project-level stratified split, accounting for code length distribution. This rigorous separation avoids cross-project contamination and ensures that performance metrics are not skewed by variations in function size. Based on the previously discussed size discrepancy, we constrained the decompilation output to half the size of the input assembly representation. The maximum input sequence length (assembly) was fixed at 512 512 tokens, while the maximum output sequence length (C code) was set to 256 256 tokens, resulting in a dataset reduction of ∼ 50 % \sim 50\% . Samples exceeding the predefined token limits were discarded to prevent code truncation and to limit computational overhead. The selected thresholds ensure a trade-off between representational expressiveness and computational feasibility. To standardize training conditions across experiments, all neural models were optimized using common hyper-parameters. Model-specific hyper-parameters, such as the number of training epochs, batch size, beam size, and evaluation frequency, were adapted according to architectural complexity, memory constraints, and expected performance. Detailed training configurations for each architecture (x86 and ARM) are reported in the Appendix 11 .

paragraphs.en: For the vulnerability detection phase, we adopted several models pretrained on large-scale code corpora. Specifically, we evaluated Qwen2.5-Coder 3B ( Hui et al., 2024 ) , DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 1.3B ( Guo et al., 2024 ) , CodeT5 ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , CodeBERT ( Feng et al., 2020 ) , CodeGPT ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , CodeParrot ( Tunstall et al., 2022 ) , GraphCodeBERT Base ( Guo et al., 2021 ) , and PLBART ( Ahmad et al., 2021 ) . GraphCodeBERT extends the capabilities of CodeBERT by incorporating the inherent structure of source code. Unlike traditional models that treat code as a simple sequence of tokens, GraphCodeBERT leverages data flow graphs.
paragraphs.zh: 在漏洞检测阶段，我们采用了多个在大规模代码语料上预训练的模型。 具体而言，我们评估了 Qwen2.5-Coder 3B（Hui et al., 2024）、DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 1.3B（Guo et al., 2024）、CodeT5（Wang et al., 2021）、CodeBERT（Feng et al., 2020）、CodeGPT（Radford et al., 2019）、CodeParrot（Tunstall et al., 2022）、GraphCodeBERT Base（Guo et al., 2021）以及 PLBART（Ahmad et al., 2021）。 GraphCodeBERT 通过引入源代码的固有结构，扩展了 CodeBERT 的能力。 与将代码视为简单词元序列的传统模型不同，GraphCodeBERT 利用了数据流图。

paragraphs.en: To ensure architectural consistency for the classification task, encoder-only models (e.g., CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT) were directly fine-tuned with a classification head. For encoder–decoder models (e.g., CodeT5 and PLBART), we followed the approach established by Wang et al. (2021) , retaining only the encoder component to extract sequence representations. For decoder-only models (e.g., CodeGPT and CodeParrot, based on the GPT architecture), we employed the standard sequence classification variant established by Radford et al. (2019) , where prediction is performed using the hidden state of the last non-padding token.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保分类任务的架构一致性，仅编码器模型（如 CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT）直接通过附加分类头进行微调。 对于编码器–解码器模型（如 CodeT5 和 PLBART），我们遵循 Wang 等人 （2021）提出的方法，仅保留编码器组件以提取序列表示。 对于仅解码器模型（如基于 GPT 架构的 CodeGPT 和 CodeParrot），我们采用 Radford 等人 （2019）确立的标准序列分类变体，即使用最后一个非填充标记的隐藏状态进行预测。

paragraphs.en: To ensure consistency with the decompilation pipeline and enable a fair comparison between the source and decompiled code, input sequences were constrained to a maximum length of 256 tokens. This filtering step significantly reduced the number of vulnerable instances and further exacerbated the original class imbalance ( 3 % 3\% vulnerability rate).

paragraphs.en: To address the severe class imbalance of the dataset, we introduced a validation phase aimed at identifying the optimal imbalance mitigation strategy . For each model, we benchmarked different mitigation techniques on the validation set, which was intentionally kept imbalanced ( 3 % 3\% vulnerability prevalence) to mirror a realistic distribution. We evaluated the impact of standard training ( Raw ), cost-sensitive learning via Class Weighting ( CW ), and various configurations of Under-Sampling ( US ) aimed at altering the training distribution. The configuration that yielded the best trade-off between minority-class precision and recall on the validation set was then selected as the definitive training pipeline. The dataset is partitioned into training, validation, and test sets using a stratified 90 / 5 / 5 90/5/5 split to preserve class balance across all subsets. Further details on hyper-parameter tuning and training splits are provided in the Appendix 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决数据集严重的类别不平衡问题，我们引入了一个验证阶段，旨在识别最优的不平衡缓解策略。 对于每个模型，我们在验证集上对不同缓解技术进行了基准测试，该验证集被有意保持不平衡（3% 3\%的漏洞占比），以反映真实的分布情况。 我们评估了标准训练（Raw）、通过类别加权（CW）实现的代价敏感学习，以及旨在改变训练分布的多种欠采样（US）配置的影响。 随后，将验证集上在少数类精确率与召回率之间取得最佳权衡的配置选定为最终的训练流程。 数据集采用分层 90 / 5 / 5 90/5/5 划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，以保持所有子集的类别平衡。 关于超参数调优和训练划分的更多细节见附录 11。

BLEU-4 evaluates n-gram precision, and ROUGE-L captures structural and semantic overlaps. paragraphs.en: Across both x86 and ARM datasets, Qwen2.5-Coder ( Hui et al., 2024 ) achieves the strongest overall performance, reaching an Edit Similarity of 55.83% on x86 and 56.60% on ARM, while dominating the token-level context coverage with a ROUGE-L score of 56.45% (x86) and 55.96% (ARM). paragraphs.en: Small, pure autoregressive models, i.e., CodeGPT ( Radford et al., 2019 ) and CodeParrot ( Tunstall et al., 2022 ) , fail drastically on this task. paragraphs.en: The results further reveal a non-uniform influence of the target ISA on performance. For CodeT5 and Qwen, ARM binaries slightly outperform x86 across most metrics, suggesting a more regular or learnable instruction-to-source mapping. By contrast, DeepSeek, CodeBERT, and PLBART exhibit a more pronounced degradation on ARM, indicating greater sensitivity to architectural variation. Overall, however, no consistent trend clearly favors one ISA over the other, although the ARM architecture instruction set displays marginally lower syntactic complexity than x86, consistent with its RISC principles of fixed-length instructions, limited addressing modes, and a highly regular operand structure.
paragraphs.zh: 结果进一步揭示了目标指令集架构（ISA）对性能的非均匀影响。 对于 CodeT5 和 Qwen，ARM 二进制文件在大多数指标上略优于 x86，这表明其指令到源代码的映射更具规律性或更易学习。 相比之下，DeepSeek、CodeBERT 和 PLBART 在 ARM 上表现出更明显的性能下降，表明它们对架构差异更为敏感。 然而，总体而言，没有一致的趋势明确显示某一 ISA 优于另一个，尽管 ARM 架构的指令集表现出略低于 x86 的句法复杂度，这与它遵循 RISC 原则的定长指令、有限寻址模式以及高度规整的操作数结构相一致。

paragraphs.en: In terms of structural alignment, our framework yields a substantial improvement, reaching an edit similarity of 32.82%, which noticeably exceeds the scores of the other evaluated models. As expected, the baseline Ghidra exhibits a low Edit Similarity of 6.19%. This occurs because rule-based decompilers focus on functional reconstruction rather than matching human coding styles, often generating nested structures, unpromoted types, and generic variable names that fail to compile directly or match the reference source text.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 summarizes the validation results for the encoder-only CodeBERT model to identify the optimal class-imbalance mitigation strategy. To ensure a valid assessment, all configurations are evaluated on a validation set that preserves the operational distribution ( 3 % 3\% vulnerability prevalence). We benchmarked several under-sampling (US) configurations, systematically varying the majority-to-minority class ratios, namely 50:50, 70:30, and 80:20. In tandem, we evaluated a cost-sensitive class weighting (CW) scheme designed to penalize minority-class misclassifications. Specifically, the weight assigned to each class was defined as inversely proportional to its training prevalence; for instance, under the 80:20 US configuration, the resulting class weights are set to 1:4 for the majority and minority classes, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 表4总结了仅编码器（encoder-only）的CodeBERT模型在识别最优类别不平衡缓解策略方面的验证结果。 为确保评估的有效性，所有配置均在一个保持实际运行分布（3% 3\% 漏洞流行率）的验证集上进行评估。 我们对多种欠采样（US）配置进行了基准测试，系统地改变多数类与少数类的比例，即50:50、70:30和80:20。 与此同时，我们评估了一种代价敏感的类别加权（CW）方案，该方案旨在对少数类的错误分类施加惩罚。 具体而言，分配给每个类别的权重被定义为其训练流行率的倒数；例如，在80:20的US配置下，多数类和少数类的类别权重分别设为1:4。

paragraphs.en: The empirical results highlight a sharp trade-off between precision and recall. Standard training configurations ( Raw and Raw + CW ) under-represent the minority class, leading to negligible recall. Conversely, a perfectly balanced training distribution, US 50-50, over-compensates, causing an unacceptable collapse in precision ( 0.070 0.070 ) and a severe degradation of the macro F1-score. The data indicate that shifting towards moderate under-sampling ratios stabilizes the model. For CodeBERT , the best performance across all integrated metrics is achieved by the hybrid US 80-20 + CW strategy, which yields the top Vul-Recall ( 0.415 0.415 ) and Macro F1-score ( 0.599 0.599 ). We extended this validation setup to one model per architecture family in Appendix 12 . The US 80-20 + CW configuration consistently proved to be the optimal choice for the majority of architectures. However, for Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder architectures, the balanced US 50-50 ratio yielded the highest overall performance, suggesting a higher tolerance for class balance adjustments. Consequently, each model was trained using its respective optimal configuration in the subsequent evaluation phases.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果凸显了精确率与召回率之间的尖锐权衡。 标准训练配置（ Raw 和 Raw + CW ）对少数类的代表性不足，导致召回率几乎可以忽略不计。 相反，完全均衡的训练分布 US 50-50 则过度补偿，导致精确率（ 0.070 0.070 ）出现不可接受的崩溃，以及宏 F1 分数的严重下降。 数据表明，向适度的欠采样比例调整能够使模型趋于稳定。 对于 CodeBERT ，在所有综合指标上表现最佳的是 US 80-20 + CW 混合策略，该策略取得了最高的漏洞召回率（ 0.415 0.415 ）和宏 F1 分数（ 0.599 0.599 ）。 我们在附录 12 中将这一验证设置扩展到了每个架构家族的一个模型上。 US 80-20 + CW 配置始终被证明是大多数架构的最优选择。 然而，对于 Qwen2.5-Coder 和 DeepSeek-Coder 架构，均衡的 US 50-50 比例取得了最高的整体性能，这表明它们对类别均衡调整具有更高的容忍度。 因此，在后续评估阶段中，每个模型均使用其各自的最优配置进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Among the evaluated neural architectures, PLBART ( Ahmad et al., 2021 ) achieves the best results for the security task, maximizing both Vul-Recall ( 0.444 0.444 ) and Vul-F1 ( 0.257 0.257 ). Encoder-based models (CodeBERT and GraphCodeBERT) track closely, maintaining a balanced trade-off with a Vul-F1 of approximately 0.24 0.24 . Conversely, decoder-only architectures, i.e., CodeParrot and CodeGPT, along with standard seq2seq baselines CodeT5, experience a visible performance degradation on the minority class, showing lower precision and restricted recall profiles. A particularly notable trend emerges when examining larger model architectures ( > 1 ​ B >1\text{B} parameters). Despite their superior parameter scale, these models fail to outperform significantly smaller encoder and sequence-to-sequence networks. DeepSeek-Coder and Qwen2.5-Coder report Vul-F1 scores of 0.213 0.213 and 0.226 0.226 , respectively, placing them in the lower range of learning-based models. Our observation that larger models do not strictly yield superior performance mirrors empirical findings in the literature ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , where scaling model parameters similarly produced non-monotonic improvements in vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 在所评估的神经架构中，PLBART（Ahmad et al., 2021）在安全任务上取得了最佳结果，同时最大化了 Vul-Recall（0.444 0.444）和 Vul-F1（0.257 0.257）。 基于编码器的模型（CodeBERT 和 GraphCodeBERT）紧随其后，保持了平衡的权衡，其 Vul-F1 约为 0.24 0.24。 相反，仅解码器架构，即 CodeParrot 和 CodeGPT，以及标准的 seq2seq 基线 CodeT5，在少数类上出现了明显的性能下降，表现出较低的精确率和受限的召回率表现。 在考察更大的模型架构（> 1 ​ B >1\text{B} 参数）时，出现了一个特别值得注意的趋势。 尽管这些模型拥有更优越的参数规模，但它们未能显著超越规模小得多的编码器和序列到序列网络。 DeepSeek-Coder 和 Qwen2.5-Coder 的 Vul-F1 分数分别为 0.213 0.213 和 0.226 0.226，处于基于学习的模型的较低区间。 我们观察到更大的模型并不严格带来更优的性能，这与文献（Chen et al., 2023）中的实证结果相呼应，其中扩大模型参数同样在漏洞检测中产生了非单调的改进。

paragraphs.en: We integrate two industry-standard, rule-based security and reverse-engineering tools into our evaluation. For the translation stage, we employ Ghidra ( National Security Agency, 2019 ) 2 2 2 Since Ghidra cannot process isolated assembly code without a complete binary structure, we built a preprocessing pipeline that leverages Keystone ( Quynh and others, 2024 ) to turn target function fragments back into raw executable binaries, allowing Ghidra’s headless mode to decompile them. , a widely adopted software reverse engineering framework driven by deterministic, rule-based decompilation heuristics. For the vulnerability detection stage, we adopt Flawfinder ( Wheeler, 2021 ) , a well-established static analysis tool that scans source code for security flaws by matching rigid syntactic patterns.

paragraphs.en: To assess the joint impact of decompilation quality on downstream security tasks, we perform an end-to-end evaluation testing four distinct pipeline configurations. Specifically, our experiments contrast the fully traditional pipeline ( Ghidra → \rightarrow Flawfinder ) against our fully neural framework VulDec, alongside two cross-combined hybrid configurations ( Ghidra → \rightarrow VD-Det and VD-Dec → \rightarrow Flawfinder ). This cross-evaluation allows us to isolate the individual contributions of both the decompilation and the detection components under realistic conditions.

paragraphs.en: End-to-End Pipeline Analysis and Cross-Evaluation. The traditional rule-based pipeline, i.e., Ghidra → \rightarrow Flawfinder , fails entirely in this realistic setup and collapses on the minority class, reporting a Vul-F1 of 0.00 0.00 . This highlights the inability of rigid syntactic pattern-matchers to generalize over the structural variations generated during standard decompilation. This architectural limitation is slightly resolved by our neural decompiler, which establishes a superior baseline over Ghidra. It shows a strong regularizing effect on downstream tools. Replacing Ghidra with VD-Dec allows even a traditional analyzer, i.e., Flawfinder, to capture vulnerabilities ( Vul-F1 = 0.05 \text{Vul-F1}=0.05 ). The fully neural pipeline, VD-Dec → \rightarrow VD-Det , achieves the best performance, maximizing Vul-Recall ( 0.28 0.28 ) and tracking the highest global F1-score.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端流水线分析与交叉评估。 传统的基于规则的流水线，即 Ghidra → \rightarrow Flawfinder，在这种现实设置下完全失效，并在少数类上崩溃，报告的 Vul-F1 为 0.00 0.00。 这凸显了僵化的句法模式匹配器无法对标准反编译过程中产生的结构变化进行泛化。 这一架构上的局限被我们的神经反编译器略微缓解，它建立了一个优于 Ghidra 的基线。 它对下游工具展现出强大的正则化效果。 用 VD-Dec 替换 Ghidra 后，即使是传统分析器（即 Flawfinder）也能捕获漏洞（ Vul-F1 = 0.05 \text{Vul-F1}=0.05 ）。 全神经流水线 VD-Dec → \rightarrow VD-Det 取得了最佳性能，将 Vul-Recall 最大化至（ 0.28 0.28 ），并保持最高的全局 F1 分数。

paragraphs.en: This behavior exemplifies a classic out-of-distribution generalization problem , a well-documented limitation in the current state-of-the-art. Recent benchmarks, such as Li et al. (2025) , prove that high in-distribution performance is often a misleading metric driven by spurious correlations, showing severe accuracy drops, e.g., from 0.70 0.70 to 0.49 0.49 , when models are exposed to real-world OOD test sets. Similarly, Chakraborty et al. (2022) highlights that evaluating deep learning models on real-world test sets with different distributions triggers a disastrous average performance drop of ∼ − 73 % \sim-73\% . The DiverseVul classifier ( Chen et al., 2023 ) suffers a massive architectural collapse under a comparable domain shift, with its reported Macro F1-score dropping from 0.472 0.472 on the ID test set to a near-baseline 0.110 0.110 on the OOD test set. To further underline this vulnerability, frameworks like SLODA ( Du et al., 2025 ) even exploit OOD features to intentionally mislead code models via adversarial attacks. More broadly, while an ID test set evaluates models on familiar software patterns encountered during training, an OOD set forces them to generalize over entirely novel coding conventions and library abstractions. paragraphs.en: Correlation Analysis. To rigorously validate these empirical observations, we performed a statistical correlation analysis examining the relationships between Edit Similarity, Accuracy, F1-score, and code scale using Spearman’s rank ( ρ \rho ) and Point-Biserial correlation tests at a 95 % 95\% confidence level ( α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ). The results reveal a clear decoupling between syntactic fidelity and security semantics . Specifically, while Accuracy significantly correlates with structural quality, the F1-score shows no statistically meaningful dependency on Edit Similarity. This finding means that generating syntactically or structurally similar code does not inherently help the downstream model in capturing subtle security vulnerabilities. Furthermore, code scale acts as a penalty on generation performance: a larger function length (higher token count) significantly degrades both Edit Similarity and Accuracy, yet displays no statistically significant impact on the vulnerability detection F1-score.
paragraphs.zh: 相关性分析。 为了严格验证这些经验性观察结果，我们进行了统计相关性分析，在 95 % 95\% 置信水平（ α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ）下，使用斯皮尔曼等级相关（ ρ \rho ）和点二列相关检验，考察编辑相似度、准确率、F1 分数与代码规模之间的关系。 结果显示，句法保真度与安全语义之间存在明显的解耦。 具体而言，虽然准确率与结构质量显著相关，但 F1 分数与编辑相似度之间不存在统计上有意义的依赖关系。 这一发现意味着，生成句法或结构上相似的代码，并不天然有助于下游模型捕捉细微的安全漏洞。 此外，代码规模会对生成性能造成惩罚：更长的函数（更高的 token 数）会显著降低编辑相似度和准确率，但对漏洞检测 F1 分数却没有统计上显著的影响。

paragraphs.en: Control Experiment. Finally, we conducted a control experiment by evaluating the detector directly on the source code of the OOD test set in order to rigorously isolate whether the observed OOD performance degradation stems from decompilation noise. Strikingly, the model yielded nearly identical results , with a negligible variance of ± 0.02 \pm 0.02 (maintaining a vulnerable-class recall of 0.28 0.28 and precision of 0.14 0.14 ). The control experiment alignment suggests that the decompilation process is not the primary driver of the performance drop, as the model faces the same difficulties even when analyzing clean source code. This result indicates that the detector has reached a generalization plateau; rather than capturing deep, universal security semantics, the LLM appears to rely on stylistic and syntactic details specific to the training distribution, leading to the same modest performance.
paragraphs.zh: 对照实验。 最后，我们进行了一项对照实验，直接在 OOD 测试集的源代码上评估检测器，以严格隔离所观察到的 OOD 性能退化是否源于反编译噪声。 令人惊讶的是，模型得到了几乎相同的结果，方差仅为 ± 0.02 \pm 0.02（漏洞类召回率保持为 0.28 0.28，精确率为 0.14 0.14）。 对照实验结果的一致性表明，反编译过程并非性能下降的主要驱动因素，因为即使在分析干净的源代码时，模型也面临同样的困难。 这一结果表明该检测器已达到泛化平台期；大语言模型（LLM）似乎并未捕捉深层的、通用的安全语义，而是依赖训练分布特有的风格和句法细节，从而导致同样平庸的性能。

paragraphs.en: The behavior of the vulnerability detection model was analyzed across vulnerability categories to assess potential category-level imbalances. The binary detection evaluation (safe vs. vulnerable) was extended to a multiclass setting using CWE annotations, allowing for the identification of both vulnerable code and specific weakness types. The VulDec dataset comprises 148 distinct CWE codes, some of which are missing. To reduce computational and interpretative complexity and to group similar vulnerability types, functions were consolidated into several macro-categories shown in Table 7 . The assignment, reported in Appendix 13 , follows a custom taxonomy inspired by MITRE categories ( The MITRE Corporation, 2024 ) and is designed to ensure that each function is annotated with its binary status, CWE identifier (when available), and the corresponding vulnerability group. Metrics are computed based on PLBART’s evaluation of the in-distribution test set.

paragraphs.en: (i) Applicability of neural decompilation to cybersecurity . The findings of this work suggest that the adoption of neural decompilation techniques for cybersecurity-related tasks constitutes a promising avenue for future research, potentially enabling new applications such as binary malware analysis. Although the decompiled C/C++ code exhibits limited syntactic fidelity, the preservation of its semantic content allows it to be effectively leveraged by learning-based approaches, which predominantly base their predictions on recurring patterns and structural features.
paragraphs.zh: （i）神经反编译在网络安全中的适用性。 本工作的研究结果表明，将神经反编译技术应用于网络安全相关任务是未来研究的一个有前景的方向，有望催生诸如二进制恶意软件分析等新的应用。 尽管反编译得到的 C/C++ 代码在语法保真度上较为有限，但其语义内容的保留使其能够被基于学习的方法有效利用，因为这类方法主要依据反复出现的模式和结构特征进行预测。

paragraphs.en: (ii) Effectiveness of VulDec Dataset . The experimental results indicate that the VulDec dataset shows promise as a viable benchmark for training both decompilation and vulnerability detection models. The evaluation on OOD test set yields encouraging outcomes, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed methodology. Nevertheless, the performance degradation observed during the training phase highlights the limitations imposed by the adopted computational resources and model capacity, suggesting that the use of more advanced architectures and greater computational power could further enhance the framework’s effectiveness. Furthermore, the joint availability of low-level representations, high-level source code, and vulnerability annotations provided by the dataset opens up several promising research directions that lie beyond the scope of the contributions presented in this work.
paragraphs.zh: (ii) VulDec 数据集的有效性。 实验结果表明，VulDec 数据集有望成为训练反编译模型和漏洞检测模型的可行基准。 在分布外（OOD）测试集上的评估取得了令人鼓舞的结果，表明所提出方法的有效性。 然而，训练阶段观察到的性能下降凸显了所采用的计算资源和模型容量带来的限制，这表明使用更先进的架构和更强大的计算能力可以进一步提升该框架的有效性。 此外，该数据集同时提供的低层表示、高层源代码以及漏洞标注，开辟了若干有前景的研究方向，这些方向超出了本文所提出贡献的范围。

paragraphs.en: (iii) VulDec Framework Deployment Context . Our empirical results indicate that while the framework achieves discrete performance, its practical utility is best realized as a first-pass screening tool to support developers during preliminary code reviews, in line with observations by Do et al. (2022) and Yedida et al. (2023) . Rather than acting as an autonomous triage system, the tool is intended to highlight potential high-risk regions to guide manual inspection, thereby reducing the search space for human experts. This lightweight decision-support role aligns well with the requirements of assistant tools in software maintenance and reverse engineering.
paragraphs.zh: (iii) VulDec 框架的部署场景。 我们的实证结果表明，虽然该框架取得了离散的性能表现，但其实际效用最适合作为初筛工具，在初步代码审查中为开发者提供支持，这与 Do 等人（2022）和 Yedida 等人（2023）的观察一致。 该工具并非作为自主分诊系统，而是旨在突出潜在的高风险区域以指导人工检查，从而缩小人类专家的搜索空间。 这种轻量级的决策支持角色很好地契合了软件维护与逆向工程中辅助工具的需求。

paragraphs.en: This work builds upon our previous exploratory study by Cotroneo et al. (2025b) , in which we introduced a preliminary pipeline for binary vulnerability detection based on neural decompilation. While this study demonstrated the feasibility of the approach, it relied on synthetically generated data, specifically the Juliet dataset ( NIST, 2017 ) , thus limiting its applicability to real-world software. In contrast, the present work addresses this limitation by introducing VulDec, an ad-hoc dataset constructed from real-world projects, and by extending the proposed pipeline to support multiple architectures, including both x86 and ARM, whereas the previous study was restricted to x86 binaries.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作在我们之前由 Cotroneo 等人（2025b）开展的探索性研究基础上展开。 在那项研究中，我们提出了一种基于神经反编译的二进制漏洞检测的初步流水线。 虽然该研究证明了这一方法的可行性，但其依赖于合成生成的数据，具体为 Juliet 数据集（NIST, 2017），因此限制了其在真实世界软件中的适用性。 相比之下，本工作通过引入 VulDec——一个由真实世界项目构建的专用数据集——来解决这一局限，并将所提出的流水线扩展为支持包括 x86 和 ARM 在内的多种架构，而之前的研究仅限于 x86 二进制文件。

paragraphs.en: Neural decompilation is an innovative research trend in binary analysis. Recent work has explored the use of learning-based approaches for binary decompilation. Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt (2022) introduced Beyond The C , a neural decompiler based on the fairseq transformer. This solution is retargetable for several high-level programming languages, such as C, OCaml, Go, and Fortran. The results of their study are promising for all languages, scoring the best result in terms of ED ( 54 % 54\% ) on the decompilation of C/C++ code (training on 2,000,000 2,000,000 samples). Katz et al. (2018) proposed an approach for neural decompilation using Recurrent Neural Networks. The solution was trained and evaluated on snippets of binary machine code compiled from C source code. This solution achieved an ED equal to 30 % 30\% , training on about 700,000 700,000 samples. Tan et al. (2024) introduced a family of large-scale LLMs called LLM4Decompile , trained to translate binary code into high-level source code, achieving substantial improvements in readability and re-executability over traditional tools such as Ghidra ( National Security Agency, 2019 ) and general-purpose models.

paragraphs.en: While the previously mentioned works ( Hosseini and Dolan-Gavitt, 2022 ; Katz et al., 2018 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) focus on improving the quality of decompiled code as an end goal, our work differs by leveraging neural decompilation as an intermediate stage for downstream cybersecurity tasks, specifically black-box binary vulnerability detection, and by introducing a curated dataset that jointly aligns assembly, source-level semantics, and fine-grained vulnerability annotations. Existing approaches to binary vulnerability detection vary widely in terms of data sources, intermediate representations, learning paradigms, and evaluation methodologies, which makes direct experimental comparison across studies inherently challenging. Zheng et al. (2019) devised an approach to identify vulnerabilities in binary files using deep learning models, particularly Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). To this end, this work leverages the Juliet C/C++ dataset ( NIST, 2017 ) . Then, the binary code is lifted to LLVM ( The LLVM Foundation, 2024 ) intermediate representation (IR), constituting the input for the RNNs. This solution can identify 4 CWEs with 90% accuracy. Schaad and Binder (2023) extended the previous approach ( Zheng et al., 2019 ) , leveraging several DL models, i.e., Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Long-Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). Their solution can identify if a binary file is vulnerable with 88% accuracy, and classify 23 CWEs out of the 118 described in the Juliet dataset with 77% accuracy. Pewny et al. (2015) designed a cross-architecture solution to identify bug signatures in binary executables: the binaries are lifted to IR to unify the different assembly languages and then converted to control flow graphs (CFG) to compare basic blocks to the known signatures. This solution can identify 5 technology-specific vulnerabilities across three architectures (ARM, MIPS, x86), including the well-known Heartbleed vulnerability for OpenSSL ( NIST, 2014 ; Synopsys, Inc., 2014 ) . DiscovRE ( Eschweiler et al., 2016 ) is a prototype for identifying binary code bugs. It can identify two vulnerabilities, i.e., Heartbleed and POODLE for OpenSSL and SSLv3 respectively, and supports four architectures, namely x86, x64, ARM, and MIPS. DiscovRE measures structural similarities between the target code and the vulnerable prototype through custom numeric features and metrics to identify the vulnerabilities. Dahl et al.

paragraphs.en: Concurrently, recent advancements in source-level vulnerability detection have shifted toward multi-agent LLM reasoning frameworks. For instance, VulTrial ( Widyasari et al., 2025 ) uses a courtroom-inspired multi-agent paradigm with role-specific agents to debate and explain source-level bugs. Similarly, AEGIS ( Fang et al., 2026 ) executes multi-agent forensic verification over repository-level Code Property Graphs (CPG) to mitigate hallucinations. Crucially, the modular nature of our pipeline allows these sophisticated verification engines to be seamlessly integrated as alternative, high-fidelity downstream backends operating directly on our decompiled pseudo-C representation.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，源码级漏洞检测的最新进展已转向基于多智能体的大语言模型推理框架。 例如，VulTrial（Widyasari et al., 2025）采用受法庭启发的多智能体范式，利用具有特定角色的智能体来辩论和解释源码级缺陷。 类似地，AEGIS（Fang et al., 2026）在仓库级代码属性图（CPG）上执行多智能体取证验证，以缓解幻觉问题。 至关重要的是，我们流水线的模块化特性使这些先进的验证引擎能够作为替代性的高保真下游后端被无缝集成，直接作用于我们反编译得到的伪 C 表示。

paragraphs.en: Most of the previously mentioned approaches to binary vulnerability detection rely on intermediate representations such as assembly-level tokens ( Dahl et al., 2020 ) , LLVM IR ( Schaad and Binder, 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2019 ) , call graphs ( Eschweiler et al., 2016 ) , or combinations thereof ( Pewny et al., 2015 ) . To the best of our knowledge, none of these methods exploit decompiled C/C++ pseudo-code as the primary representation. This constitutes a key distinguishing aspect of our approach, as it not only enables vulnerability prediction but also provides an interpretable approximation of the original source code from which the binary was compiled. Furthermore, many of the strong classification results reported in the literature ( Cotroneo et al., 2025b ; Schaad and Binder, 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2019 ) , particularly in multi-class settings, are largely attributable to the use of synthetic benchmarks. Our findings ( Cotroneo et al., 2025b ) , achieving up to 90% accuracy, corroborate this observation and highlight the impact of dataset realism on reported performance.

paragraphs.en: (i) Dataset Construction and Integrity . A key threat to validity arises from function matching between source code and assembly representations, which relies on symbol-name equality. To evaluate alignment fidelity in the absence of independent binary verification, we conducted a manual audit on 100 100 randomly sampled function pairs, confirming correct alignment in 95 % 95\% of cases ( 95 % 95\% Wilson CI [ 88.7 % , 98.0 % ] [88.7\%,98.0\%] ). This suggests reasonable empirical accuracy for symbol-based alignment, indicating that incorrect function associations introduce minimal noise. Beyond alignment integrity, since our dataset builds upon DiverseVul ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , it directly inherits its documented 5 − 15 % 5-15\% label noise alongside its inherent class imbalance across vulnerability categories.

paragraphs.en: (ii) Model selection and adaptation . The validity of the results may also be affected by the choice of learning models ( Hui et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2020 ; Guo et al., 2021 ; Radford et al., 2019 ; Tunstall et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) and their associated adaptation configurations. While smaller encoder-based and sequence-to-sequence baselines underwent full fine-tuning, computational resource constraints needed adapting larger generative LLMs, e.g., Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder, via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) over 3 epochs. While the selected models and fine-tuning regimes reflect widely adopted state-of-the-art approaches, this architectural and adaptation heterogeneity introduces a potential confounding factor, as more extensive hyperparameter optimization could influence model capacity.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced VulDec, a novel large-scale dataset that aligns C/C++ vulnerability annotations with their corresponding assembly representations, together with an end-to-end framework that leverages large language model–based neural decompilation for binary vulnerability detection. By translating binary executables into source-level pseudo-code and treating both representations as textual artifacts, our approach demonstrates how neural decompilation can serve as an effective abstraction for downstream cybersecurity tasks. Our primary objective was to advance research in black-box binary vulnerability detection by enabling realistic, data-driven studies and highlighting the potential of neural decompilation as a unifying bridge between low-level binaries and source-level semantics. The experimental evaluation of out-of-distribution, real-world binaries highlights the effectiveness and limitations of the proposed approach.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 VulDec，一个新颖的大规模数据集，它将 C/C++ 漏洞标注与相应的汇编表示进行对齐，同时还提出了一个端到端框架，该框架利用基于大语言模型的神经反编译来进行二进制漏洞检测。 通过将二进制可执行文件翻译为源码级伪代码，并将两种表示都视为文本产物，我们的方法展示了神经反编译如何作为下游网络安全任务的有效抽象。 我们的首要目标是通过支持现实的、数据驱动的研究，并凸显神经反编译作为底层二进制与源码级语义之间统一桥梁的潜力，来推进黑盒二进制漏洞检测的研究。 针对分布外真实世界二进制文件的实验评估凸显了所提方法的有效性与局限性。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 summarizes the key parameters used in the VulDec pipeline. The workflow follows a progressively decreasing input/output size: the first stage processes assembly code with a maximum length of 512 tokens and generates C/C++ code limited to 256 tokens, while the final output encodes binary vulnerability information (0/1). This design reflects the hierarchical nature of the task, moving from low-level instructions to high-level program semantics and finally to a compact, security-relevant representation. The dataset splits are chosen to balance sufficient training data with effective evaluation, using 90/5/5 for both tasks, ensuring model generalization and robust testing. A block of parameters, i.e., decision threshold, batch size, gradient accumulation, number of epochs, and beam size, was adapted for each model and each task to balance computational constraints, training time, and performance expectations, reflecting differences in model complexity and architecture. Training budgets were scaled by architecture and pre-training capacity. Encoder-decoder models (CodeT5, PLBART) required longer schedules (up to 10 10 epochs) for cross-attention alignment. Conversely, large decoder-only LLMs (Qwen, DeepSeek) were capped at 3 3 epochs to prevent overfitting. Smaller decoder-only models (CodeGPT, CodeParrot) were allocated an intermediate budget ( 5 5 – 8 8 epochs) to compensate for their lower capacity, while encoder-only models received minimal epochs due to their generative unsuitability.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 总结了 VulDec 流水线中使用的关键参数。 工作流遵循输入/输出规模逐步递减的方式：第一阶段处理最大长度为 512 个词元的汇编代码，并生成限制在 256 个词元以内的 C/C++ 代码，而最终输出编码的是二进制漏洞信息（0/1）。 这种设计反映了任务的层次性，即从低级指令过渡到高级程序语义，最后到一个紧凑的、与安全相关的表示。 数据集划分的选择旨在平衡充足的训练数据与有效的评估，两个任务均采用 90/5/5 的划分比例，以确保模型的泛化能力和可靠的测试。 一组参数，即决策阈值、批大小、梯度累积、训练轮数和束宽，针对每个模型和每个任务进行了调整，以平衡计算限制、训练时间和性能预期，这反映了模型复杂度和架构上的差异。 训练预算根据架构和预训练能力进行了相应缩放。 编码器-解码器模型（CodeT5、PLBART）需要更长的训练周期（最多 10 10 个 epoch）以实现交叉注意力对齐。 相反，大型仅解码器 LLM（Qwen、DeepSeek）被限制在 3 3 个 epoch，以防止过拟合。 较小的仅解码器模型（CodeGPT、CodeParrot）被分配了中间规模的训练预算（5 5 到 8 8 个 epoch），以弥补其较低的容量，而仅编码器模型由于其不适合生成任务，只分配了最少的 epoch。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 12 , for standard encoder-based backbones as well as small decoder-only models, the combination of US 80-20 + CW consistently achieves the best balance between precision and recall, yielding the highest Vul-F1 and Macro F1 scores. Conversely, for modern decoder-only LLMs, the US 50-50 sampling ratio proves to be the most effective strategy. Since class weights are defined as inversely proportional to the training class distribution, applying CW to a 50-50 balanced dataset results in a weight ratio of 1:1, making loss weighting mathematically redundant. Therefore, class balance was controlled entirely via dataset resampling without additional loss weighting.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 12 所示，对于基于标准编码器的主干模型以及小型仅解码器模型，US 80-20 + CW 的组合始终在精确率与召回率之间取得最佳平衡，获得最高的 Vul-F1 和 Macro F1 分数。 相反，对于现代仅解码器大语言模型，US 50-50 采样比例被证明是最有效的策略。 由于类别权重定义为与训练类别分布成反比，在 50-50 平衡数据集上应用 CW 会导致权重比为 1:1，使得损失加权在数学上是多余的。 因此，类别平衡完全通过数据集重采样来控制，未使用额外的损失加权。

paragraphs.en: Tier 1: Perfect Structural Match and Contextual Renaming . This tier represents the ideal success scenario for our neural framework. As shown in the store_tabletJitterDelay routine from the Linux Kernel input subsystem, the generated control-flow graph and syntactic blocks mirror the ground truth perfectly. The marginal reduction in the ES score (95.21%) is exclusively caused by a variable renaming effect, where the original single-character identifier j is translated into delay . paragraphs.en: Tier 2: Syntactic Shift with Functional Equivalence . The second tier highlights cases where the model demonstrates a deep semantic understanding derived from its pre-training phase. In the i2c_smbus_read_byte_data function, the ground truth implements a compact inline instruction: return (status < 0) ? status : data.byte; . VulDec decompiler successfully interprets the low-level conditional branch layout but decomposes it into an explicit, structurally expanded code path: if (status < 0) return status; return data.byte; . Although this syntactic variance induces a minor drop in token-level similarity (93.15%), the decompiled function remains 100% functionally equivalent.
paragraphs.zh: 层级二：句法变换但功能等价。 第二层级突出的是模型展现出源自其预训练阶段的深层语义理解的情况。 在 i2c_smbus_read_byte_data 函数中，真实答案实现了一条紧凑的内联指令：return (status < 0) ? status : data.byte; 。 VulDec 反编译器成功解读了低层级的条件分支布局，但将其分解为一条显式的、结构上展开的代码路径：if (status < 0) return status; return data.byte; 。 尽管这种句法差异导致词元级相似度出现小幅下降（93.15%），但反编译出的函数仍保持 100% 的功能等价。

paragraphs.en: Tier 3: Semantic and Type Shift . The intermediate tier (ES: 58.15%) uncovers critical insights regarding prompt-induced biases in generative models. In the cmp_extents_reverse example, the original code performs a standard three-way ascending comparison. However, the presence of the word "reverse" within the function identifier biases the autoregressive decoding, prompting the LLM to assume a descending sort order. Consequently, the model generates a specular return logic, swapping the 1 and -1 outputs. Additionally, it experiences a type misalignment, injecting an extraneous pointer indirection ( *(const struct extent_map **)a ) and swapping the uid_gid_extent type with extent_map . Despite the semantic inversion, the underlying conditional structure ( if-if-return ) is accurately preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 第3层：语义与类型偏移。 中间层（ES: 58.15%）揭示了关于生成式模型中提示词引发偏差的关键洞察。 在 cmp_extents_reverse 示例中，原始代码执行的是标准的三路升序比较。 然而，函数标识符中出现的"reverse"一词使自回归解码产生偏差，促使大语言模型（LLM）假定排序顺序为降序。 因此，该模型生成了镜像的返回逻辑，交换了 1 和 -1 这两个输出。 此外，它还出现了类型不匹配，注入了多余的指针间接引用（ *(const struct extent_map **)a ），并将 uid_gid_extent 类型误换为 extent_map 。 尽管存在语义反转，底层的条件结构（ if-if-return ）仍被准确保留。

This final tier (ES: 17.62%) embodies the catastrophic failure modes typical of autoregressive language models when handling unaligned binary syntax or hard code structures. Our extensive empirical evaluations indicate that severe hallucinations generally manifest as one of four cases:

paragraphs.en: premature decoding termination immediately after generating the function signature, omitting the function body entirely;
paragraphs.zh: 在生成函数签名后立即过早地终止解码，完全省略函数体；

paragraphs.zh: 生成正确的代码块后跟任意的语法噪声、未对齐的代码路径，或同一代码块在循环中重复出现；

paragraphs.zh: 流畅地生成一个结构正确但完全不相关的函数；

paragraphs.en: a severe collapse of the model’s self-attention stopping criteria, leading to an infinite repetition loop on a single line of code.
paragraphs.zh: 模型的自注意力停止准则发生了严重崩溃，导致在单行代码上陷入无限重复循环。

After hallucinating a non-existent error-tracking structure ( errorLine , errorColumn , etc.), the decoder becomes trapped in an infinite loop, continuously reiterating identical allocation sequences until truncated by the maximum token generation boundary, leaving an incomplete and non-compilable artifact.
